## What changes

<!-- For example: "German: fixed wording in Settings" or "Japanese: reviewed the web app" -->

## Checklist

- [ ] I only changed files under `locales/<language>/` (or explained why not)
- [ ] Placeholders like `{count}`, `%@`, `%lld` or `%1$s` are still in every translation I touched
- [ ] Plural strings have every form my language needs (see `plurals` in `languages.json`)
- [ ] I followed the style notes for my language in `languages.json` and the terms in `glossary.json`
- [ ] I am a native or fluent speaker of the language I changed
